summary: A 1933 R-5 groundhouse lookout with catwalk in Custer County, reached by a 0.7-mile trail; listed as standing and registered in 2008.

facts.design: R-5 (Region 5) C-3 cab, a 14 by 14 ft groundhouse with catwalk; the design dates to 1917

access.note: Reached on a 0.7-mile Forest Service trail (#4164) that ends at the lookout. The trail page lists horseback and motorcycle riding. No closure found. No recent condition report.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in per Idaho Fire Lookouts. Cutoff trail #4164 begins at a junction with Ramey Cr #4163 and ends at the lookout.

events.note: 14 by 14 ft Region 5 groundhouse cab with catwalk erected
Last used for fire detection, per Rex's page (line garbled; conflicts with 1981 staffing)
Teresa Fleck staffed the lookout, per Idaho Fire Lookouts citing the Kellogg Evening News
Forest fire came within 100 yards of the lookout; the staffer had to be evacuated
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register, November 20, 2008

evidence.supports: built 1933, one of very few R-5 C-3 cabs in Idaho
evidence.quote: Built in 1933, Custer Lookout is one of very few R-5 C-3 cabs in Idaho.
It is a 14’x14’ groundhouse with catwalk.

evidence.supports: design dates to 1917 and precedes the L-4
evidence.quote: The design dates to 1917 and is a precursor to the popular L-4 developed in the early 1930s.
The lookout is an R-5, which is a California design, unpopular in the northwest.

evidence.supports: last used for fire detection in 1972 per Rex's page (garbled line)
evidence.quote: 1972: The lookout last used fire detection proposes.

evidence.supports: Teresa Fleck staffed in 1981, citing the Kellogg Evening News
evacuated when a forest fire came within 100 yards
evidence.quote: Had to be evacuated from tower - Forest fire came within 100 yards

evidence.supports: listed as standing in the Forest Fire Lookout Association table
evidence.quote: Custer Custer 44.34929 -114.62409 Ground Standing NHLR US 750, ID 52

evidence.supports: 0.7-mile trail #4164 from a junction with Ramey Cr #4163 to the lookout
evidence.quote: The Custer Lookout Cutoff trail is 0.7 miles long. It begins at Junction with Ramey Cr #4163 and ends at Custer Lookout.

evidence.supports: trail open to horseback and motorcycle riding
evidence.quote: The trail is open for the following uses: Horseback Riding, Motorcycle Trail Riding

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Rex's page gives 1972 as the last year the lookout was used for fire detection. Idaho Fire Lookouts reports a 1981 staffing, citing the Kellogg Evening News. Both are recorded; the story does not pick one.
The register gives 9,742 ft (2,969 m). Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 9753 ft. The brief's 2969.4 m comes from the register. Elevation is not in the facts block.

notes_for_editor: No recent condition report was found, so current state and access are unverified. The 1972 and 1981 fire-use dates conflict. Do not confuse with the town of Custer, Idaho. A 2026 Challis visitor guide mentions a 1981 National Register listing for Custer; it is unclear whether that refers to the town or the lookout, so I did not use it.
